evidence.detail: Search results are still rendered server-side with Mustache — a static <table> with {{#search_results}} iteration, no React component
ArchetypeSearch view class exists and populates search_results for Mustache rendering — no JSON/React path
The React table pattern (Table, renderRecord, createRoot) exists and is used for other pages, showing the intended target shape

triage.notes: Reactifying requires: new JSX component with checkbox support for bulk reassignment (the main complexity), a JSON API endpoint for search results, webpack bundle entry, and replacing the Mustache table. More than ~150 lines across multiple files.
